## Simulations

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plan(multicore, workers = parallel::detectCores() - 1)

# Fixed baseline values
fixed_root_length <- 1.5
fixed_root_no     <- 3e5
fixed_ecto_allo   <- 0.1

# Parameter ranges
root_length_values <- seq(1, 2, length.out = 21)
root_no_values     <- 3*10^seq(3, 8, length.out = 21)
nitrogen_values    <- seq(0.1, 100, length.out = 21)
ecto_allo_values   <- seq(0.0, 0.5, length.out = 11)

param_file <- "/home/josimms/Documents/Austria/Plant-FATE/tests/params/p_test_boreal.ini"
weather_file <- "/home/josimms/Documents/Austria/Plant-FATE/data/ERAS_Monthly.csv"

# -------------------------------
# Core simulation function with safe error handling
# -------------------------------
run_sim_parallel <- function(rl, rn, n, eb) {
  tryCatch({
    lho <- new(LifeHistoryOptimizer, param_file)
    lho$set_i_metFile(weather_file)
    lho$set_a_metFile(weather_file)
    lho$set_co2File("")
    lho$set_soil_nitrogen(n)
    lho$init()
    lho$traits0$investment_from_tree <- eb
    lho$root_override(rn, rl)
    
    dt <- 1/12
    start_year <- 1960
    end_year   <- 2022
    years_seq  <- seq(start_year, end_year, dt)
    
    results <- lapply(years_seq, function(t) {
      tryCatch({
        lho$grow_for_dt(t, dt)
        state <- lho$get_state(t + dt)
        df_row <- as.data.frame(t(state))
        names(df_row) <- lho$get_header()
        df_row
      }, error = function(e) {
        setNames(as.data.frame(as.list(rep(NA, length(lho$get_header())))),
                 lho$get_header())
      })
    })
    
    df <- do.call(rbind, results)
    df$date <- seq(as.Date(paste0(start_year, "-01-01")),
                   as.Date(paste0(end_year, "-01-01")),
                   by = "month")[1:nrow(df)]
    df$root_length   <- rl
    df$root_no       <- rn
    df$soil_nitrogen <- n
    df$ecto_allo     <- eb
    df
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Failed run_sim_parallel: rl=", rl, " rn=", rn, " n=", n, " eb=", eb)
    NULL
  })
}

# Then use future_lapply only over **simple args**, not objects:
all_n_df <- future_lapply(nitrogen_values, function(n) {
  run_sim_parallel(fixed_root_length, fixed_root_no, n, fixed_ecto_allo)
})

# --- Sweep Root Number (nitrogen iterated each time) ---
all_rn_df <- safe_future_lapply(root_no_values, function(rn) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(nitrogen_values, function(n) {
    run_sim_safe(fixed_root_length, rn, n, fixed_ecto_allo)
  })[!sapply(., is.null)])
})

# --- Sweep Root Length (nitrogen iterated each time) ---
all_rl_df <- safe_future_lapply(root_length_values, function(rl) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(nitrogen_values, function(n) {
    run_sim_safe(rl, fixed_root_no, n, fixed_ecto_allo)
  })[!sapply(., is.null)])
})

# --- Sweep Ectomycorrhizal Allocation (nitrogen iterated each time) ---
all_eb_df <- safe_future_lapply(ecto_allo_values, function(eb) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(nitrogen_values, function(n) {
    run_sim_safe(fixed_root_length, fixed_root_no, n, eb)
  })[!sapply(., is.null)])
})
```

## Trade offs: Root traits

```{r}
# --- Subset for plotting ---

# 1. Heatmap of Root Number sweep (root length fixed)
subset_rn <- all_rn_df %>%
  filter(root_length == fixed_root_length) %>%   # use your baseline root length
  filter(date == as.Date("1960-01-01"))

# 2. Heatmap of Root Length sweep (root number fixed)
subset_rl <- all_rl_df %>%
  filter(root_no == fixed_root_no) %>%          # use your baseline root number
  filter(date == as.Date("1960-01-01"))

# --- Range of fitness for consistent color scaling ---
fitness_range <- range(
  c(subset_rn$fitness, subset_rl$fitness),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# --- Max lines for root number sweep ---
max_line_rn <- subset_rn %>%
  group_by(soil_nitrogen) %>%
  slice_max(fitness, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- Max lines for root length sweep ---
max_line_rl <- subset_rl %>%
  group_by(soil_nitrogen) %>%
  slice_max(fitness, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- Plot 1: Root Number heatmap ---
p1 <- ggplot(subset_rn, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = root_no, fill = fitness)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_line(data = max_line_rn, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = root_no), color = "red", size = 1.2) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "cividis", limits = fitness_range) +
  labs(x = "Soil N (g m⁻³)",
       y = "Root Number per Unit Crown Area (log scale)",
       fill = "Fitness") +
  pub_theme

# --- Plot 2: Root Length heatmap ---
p2 <- ggplot(subset_rl, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = root_length, fill = fitness)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_line(data = max_line_rl, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = root_length), color = "red", size = 1.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "cividis", limits = fitness_range) +
  labs(x = "Soil N (g m⁻³)",
       y = "Root Length (mm)",
       fill = "Fitness") +
  pub_theme

# --- Display plots ---
p1
p2
```

# Final

```{r}
# --- Convert date column to Date class if needed ---
final_df_no_na$date <- as.Date(final_df_no_na$date)

# --- Subset for plotting ---
subset_root_length <- final_df_no_na %>%
  filter(root_length == 1.5) %>%               # fixed root length
  filter(date == as.Date("2022-01-01"))

subset_root_no <- final_df_no_na %>%
  filter(root_no == 3e5) %>%                   # fixed root number
  filter(date == as.Date("2022-01-01"))

# --- Determine total_mass range for color scaling ---
total_mass_range <- range(
  c(subset_root_length$total_mass, subset_root_no$total_mass),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# --- Compute max total_mass points ---
max_line_root_length <- subset_root_length %>%
  group_by(soil_nitrogen) %>%
  slice_max(total_mass, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

max_line_root_no <- subset_root_no %>%
  group_by(soil_nitrogen) %>%
  slice_max(total_mass, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- Plot 1: Root Number heatmap ---
p1 <- ggplot(subset_root_length, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = root_no, fill = total_mass)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_point(data = max_line_root_length,
             aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = root_no, shape = "Total Biomass maximum"),
             fill = "white", color = "black", size = 2.5, stroke = 1.2) +
  scale_shape_manual(name = NULL, values = c("Total Biomass maximum" = 21)) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "cividis", limits = total_mass_range) +
  labs(x = "Soil N (g m⁻³)",
       y = "Root Number per\nUnit Crown Area\n(no per m², log)",
       fill = "Total Biomass") +
  pub_theme

# --- Plot 2: Root Length heatmap ---
p2 <- ggplot(subset_root_no, aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = root_length, fill = total_mass)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_point(data = max_line_root_no,
             aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = root_length, shape = "Fitness maximum"),
             fill = "white", color = "black", size = 2.5, stroke = 1.2) +
  scale_shape_manual(name = NULL, values = c("Fitness maximum" = 21)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "cividis", limits = total_mass_range) +
  labs(x = "Soil N (g m⁻³)",
       y = "Root Length\n(mm)",
       fill = "Fitness") +
  pub_theme

# --- Combine plots vertically with shared legend ---
(p2 / p1) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

## Trajectory

```{r}
# --- Soil N values to plot (min, median, max) ---
soilN_values <- c(
  min(nitrogen_values),
  median(nitrogen_values),
  max(nitrogen_values)
)

# ---- Maximum-Fitness Root Number Trajectory (all ties) ----
trajectory_max_root_no <- final_df_no_na %>%
  filter(soil_nitrogen %in% soilN_values) %>%
  group_by(date, soil_nitrogen) %>%
  slice_max(total_mass, with_ties = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(date, soil_nitrogen, root_no)

# ---- Maximum-Fitness Root Length Trajectory (all ties) ----
trajectory_max_root_length <- final_df_no_na %>%
  filter(soil_nitrogen %in% soilN_values) %>%
  group_by(date, soil_nitrogen) %>%
  slice_max(total_mass, with_ties = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(date, soil_nitrogen, root_length)

# ---- Plot Root Number trajectory ----
p1 <- ggplot(trajectory_max_root_no,
             aes(x = date, y = root_no,
                 color = factor(soil_nitrogen),
                 group = soil_nitrogen)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5,
             position = position_jitter(width = 0, height = 0.05 * max(root_no_values))) +
  scale_y_log10(limits = range(root_no_values)) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "cividis") +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Maximum:\nRoot Number per Unit Crown Area (log)",
    color = "Soil N (g m⁻³)"
  ) +
  pub_theme

# ---- Plot Root Length trajectory ----
p2 <- ggplot(trajectory_max_root_length,
             aes(x = date, y = root_length,
                 color = factor(soil_nitrogen),
                 group = soil_nitrogen)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = range(root_length_values)) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "cividis") +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Maximum:\nRoot Length (mm)",
    color = "Soil N (g m⁻³)"
  ) +
  pub_theme

# ---- Combine plots vertically with shared legend ----
(p2 / p1) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

```{r}
max_biomass <- max(max_ecto_vs_soilN$ectomycorrhiza_mass, na.rm = TRUE)

max_ecto_vs_soilN <- final_df_no_na %>%
  group_by(soil_nitrogen) %>%
  slice_max(total_mass, with_ties = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(soil_nitrogen, ectomycorrhiza_mass, total_mass)

# Graph to show the nitrogen limitation side
## Nitrogen gradient biomass - should be the biomass nitrogen limitation

p1 <- ggplot(max_ecto_vs_soilN,
             aes(x = soil_nitrogen,
                 y = ectomycorrhiza_mass,
                 color = total_mass)) +  # <- now mapped
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "cividis",
                        limits = total_mass_range) +   # match root plots
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(max_ecto_vs_soilN$ectomycorrhiza_mass, na.rm = TRUE))) +
  labs(
    x = "Soil N (g m⁻³)",
    y = "Ectomycorrhizal\nBiomass (kg)",
    color = "total_mass"
  ) +
  pub_theme

# Graph to show the carbon limitation side
## Nitrogen gradient biomass - total_mass should be the carbon limitation
final_df_no_na$total_mass <- total_mass(
  costs = final_df_no_na$total_mass + 
    final_df_no_na$rs + final_df_no_na$rr + final_df_no_na$rl +
    final_df_no_na$tl + final_df_no_na$tr + 0.2 * final_df_no_na$assim_net,
  nitrogen = final_df_no_na$nitrogen_uptake
)

p2 <- ggplot(max_ecto_vs_soilN,
             aes(x = soil_nitrogen,
                 y = ectomycorrhiza_mass,
                 color = total_mass)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "cividis", limits = total_mass_range) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(max_ecto_vs_soilN$ectomycorrhiza_mass))) +
  labs(x = "Soil N (g m⁻³)", y = "Ectomycorrhizal\nAllocation (kg)", color = "total_mass") +
  pub_theme

(p1 / p2) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

```

## mean

```{r}
mean_df <- final_df_no_na %>%
  group_by(soil_nitrogen, root_no, root_length) %>%
  summarise(
    total_mass = mean(total_mass, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

mean_subset_df1 <- mean_df %>%
  filter(abs(root_length - 1.5) < 1e-6)

mean_subset_df2 <- mean_df %>%
  filter(abs(root_no - 3e5) < 1e-6 * 3e5)

p1_mean <- ggplot(mean_subset_df1,
                  aes(x = soil_nitrogen,
                      y = root_no,
                      fill = total_mass)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "cividis",
                       limits = total_mass_range_mean) +
  labs(x = "Soil N (g m⁻³)",
       y = "Root Number\nper Unit Crown Area (log)",
       fill = "Mean Total Biomass") +
  pub_theme

p2_mean <- ggplot(mean_subset_df2,
                  aes(x = soil_nitrogen,
                      y = root_length,
                      fill = total_mass)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "cividis",
                       limits = total_mass_range_mean) +
  labs(x = "Soil N (g m⁻³)",
       y = "Root Length (mm)",
       fill = "Mean Total Biomass") +
  pub_theme

# Compute maximum fitness at each soil nitrogen
max_line_df2 <- mean_subset_df2 %>%
  group_by(soil_nitrogen) %>%
  slice_max(total_mass, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# Compute maximum fitness at each soil nitrogen
max_line_df1 <- mean_subset_df1 %>%
  group_by(soil_nitrogen) %>%
  slice_max(total_mass, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

p1_mean + 
  geom_line(data = max_line_df1, 
            aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = root_no), 
            color = "red", size = 1.2)

p2_mean + 
  geom_line(data = max_line_df2, 
            aes(x = soil_nitrogen, y = root_length), 
            color = "red", size = 1.2)

total_mass_range_mean <- range(
  c(mean_subset_df1$total_mass, mean_subset_df2$total_mass),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

```

## Trade offs: Ectomycorrhizal biomass

```{r}
subset_df <- final_df_no_na %>%
  filter(root_length == 1.5, root_no == 3e5)

heatmap_ecm <- subset_df %>%
  mutate(
    bin_soilN = cut(soil_nitrogen, breaks = 50),
    bin_ecm   = cut(log10(ectomycorrhiza_mass), breaks = 50)
  ) %>%
  group_by(bin_soilN, bin_ecm) %>%
  summarise(
    total_mass = mean(total_mass, na.rm = TRUE),
    soil_nitrogen = mean(soil_nitrogen),
    ectomycorrhiza_mass = mean(ectomycorrhiza_mass),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(heatmap_ecm,
       aes(x = soil_nitrogen,
           y = ectomycorrhiza_mass,
           fill = total_mass)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_y_log10() +   # log axis if biomass spans orders
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma") +
  labs(
    x = "Soil Nitrogen (g N m⁻³)",
    y = "Ectomycorrhiza Biomass (kg)",
    fill = "total_mass"
  ) +
  pub_theme
```
